item.title: Hyderabad Road Rage: Man Hit, Dragged By Speeding Bolero for Nearly 1 Km, Left Severely Injured
item.description: A 45-year-old man in Hyderabad was dragged nearly a kilometre under a Bolero during a road rage incident on February 9 near Mallapur X Road, leaving him with severe injuries and a broken leg. The driver, reportedly using a siren and causing disturbances, is under investigation as the victim undergoes hospital treatment.

item.title: Bonnet Crushed, Seats Soaked in Blood: Five Dead in Bengaluru After Car Crashes and Topples
item.description: Five people died when their car crashed into a divider and a KSRTC bus near Jindal on Bengaluru’s Tumkur Highway. Bus passengers were unharmed; police are investigating the cause and reviewing CCTV footage.

item.title: No-Confidence Motion Against Om Birla to Be Taken Up March 9; Govt Hints at Tough Stance in Second Phase of Budget Session
item.description: The Budget Session began with the president's address to the joint sitting of Parliament on January 28 and went on recess on February 12. The Union Budget for 2026 was presented on February 1, and the session will resume on March 9, concluding on April 2.
